faces.transcription: Find card 50 from the Operations deck and place it faceup in the Operations area.
faces.flavor: "All right team, I went over your responses and have an initial evaluation. Your 'can-do' attitude is refreshing, all things considered, but remember that you're still new to this. For now, you gotta run some of your ops up the chain for approval. It's a pain, I know, but it ain't personal: pretty standard stuff for new agents."
